summary: Use native Bitcoin readiness for AssumeUTXO mining checks and deduplicate signature success notices
details: Mining preflight uses the same pinned baseline and foreground readiness contract as native node startup, allowing background historical validation to continue while retaining all upstream and miner eligibility gates.
Native Bitcoin RPC outages and probe timeouts remain blocking and report their cause explicitly.
Repeated validation of the same signed artifact emits one success notice per process while still checking every signature and the current trusted key catalog.
